title: MCP Evidence Contract x-evidence-contract v0.1
description: Portable, additive, transport- and vendor-neutral evidence-capability declaration that MAY be attached to an MCP tool description under the 'x-evidence-contract' key. A declaration is a claim about the tool contract, not proof that any particular invocation satisfied it. tool_declares_capability != invocation_produced_artifact != artifact_verified != evidence_supported != admitted != published. This extension is additive only: an existing MCP tool descriptor that omits it remains fully valid, and the extension carries no authority, admission, or publication effect (authority_effect is fixed to 'none' in v0.1).

contract_version.description: Fixed identity of this contract schema version. Consumers that do not recognize a contract_version MUST fail closed (ignore or reject the extension) rather than guess semantics.

output_kind.description: Generic, vendor-neutral token naming the kind of output the tool produces (e.g. 'source_candidate', 'captured_source'). MUST NOT encode a product-specific record identity (e.g. no Counterpedia record identities, no SAM node identities).

exact_bytes_available.description: Whether the tool's output is claimed to carry the exact bytes of the underlying artifact, as opposed to a paraphrase, summary, or rendering.

stable_identity_available.description: Whether the tool's output is claimed to carry an identity reference stable enough to re-resolve the same artifact across invocations.

digest_available.description: Whether the tool's output is claimed to carry a content digest of the artifact.

digest_algorithm.description: The digest algorithm promised when digest_available is true. MUST be null when digest_available is false, and MUST be a recognized algorithm token (never a prose description) when digest_available is true.

retrieval_observation_available.description: Whether the tool's output is claimed to carry an observation of the retrieval event itself (e.g. that a fetch occurred), independent of the fetched content's truth.

provenance_lineage_ref_available.description: Whether the tool's output is claimed to carry a reference to the artifact's provenance/lineage chain, as a reference only (never inline provenance content).

eligible_uses.description: Closed vocabulary of v0.1 eligible uses. Values that would assert admission, publication, or factual-truth standing are structurally excluded from this enum, never merely discouraged.

ineligible_uses.description: v0.1 fixes the ineligible-use vocabulary to exactly {admission, publication, factual_truth}. A declaration MUST always disclose all three as ineligible; none of the three may be omitted or reclassified as eligible.

authority_effect.description: Fixed to 'none' in v0.1. This extension never grants, implies, or upgrades admission, publication, or verification standing.
